rule: work/ is gitignored: a clean clone has none of it. Large raw evidence is provided by the declared archives below; a MISSING dependency must fail loudly and must never be skipped silently -- an empty-but-plausible artifact is not an answer.

remote_archive.restore_path: ensemble_hpc_io.py --package <pkg> --job-id <id> for ensemble packages; the main-state packages are plain uploaded trees

derived_layer_tracked.meaning: the folded values of EVERY main-state leg survive in git, so the project's conclusions do not depend on this machine's work/ layer

raw_main_state_split.declared_limitation: the 25 local-only legs' RAW ORCA outputs exist only on this machine; 23 of them are superseded by the tracked derived ledger and 2 are scratch saddle-repair attempts. Re-analysing a local leg from its original output is therefore NOT reproducible from a declared archive -- the conclusion is, the re-analysis is not.

git_history_dependency.fallback: walk git log for the last revision without WP2_PRODUCTION_LEDGER
git_history_dependency.requirement: a FULL clone: a shallow clone has no unpatched revision and raises SystemExit('找不到未打补丁的生成器基线') -- loud, as required

not_archived_but_reproducible.work/sampling/**: GFN2 screening cache; re-running the screening regenerates it

not_archived_and_not_reproducible.work/recheck/**: the folded pair-recheck raw table; NOT on the remote and not regenerated by any chain step -- a declared gap
